# Tales of You

> Tales of You is a personalized children's book platform. Parents pick a story, add their child's name and photo, and our AI generates a fully illustrated book with characters that look like their family. Stories are written by real authors for kids aged 2–12. Read together, save to your library, or share with grandparents. Currently in beta; join the waitlist for early access.

Tales of You is different from template-based personalized books: our stories are written by real authors and our AI creates unique illustrations based on your child's actual appearance. Every story, character, and page is one-of-a-kind. You can add siblings, parents, grandparents, friends, or even the family pet. The roadmap includes audio narration, animated illustrations, and choose-your-own-adventure branching storylines.
